extraction.Name: Charlotte Giroux Burnett
extraction.Refused/Protested: No, I thought that it was issued and it was up to me to take it.
extraction.Occupation/Income: My husband is dead and the children and I farm and milk a few cows and so forth.
extraction.NOTES: Husband is deceased; nine dependents; was satisfied with the sale and stated she got a good price; patent was brought home by her husband at some point she does not remember; did not remember signing a receipt for it; consideration was a cash deal; subscribed and sworn before A.W. Cross, Notary Public, commission expires 4-28-32, on May 14, 1929.
